subject.title: [Feature] Allow configuring Gemini safety settings in OpenClaw

question: Should OpenClaw expose a typed Gemini safety-settings configuration, and if so which Google routes, allowed values, and request-level precedence are supported?
rationale: The change adds a compatibility-sensitive provider configuration surface that can relax upstream safety filtering; source inspection confirms the feature is absent, but implementation cannot safely choose the permanent policy contract on its own.

options.title: Approve a narrow Google-only contract
options.body: Add validated Google Generative AI safety settings with explicit request-level values taking precedence, plus focused docs and regression coverage.

options.title: Keep provider defaults
options.body: Decline a first-class override and retain Google’s default safety behavior until a broader provider-policy design is approved.

options.title: Request a revised design
options.body: Ask for a provider-owned proposal that specifies route coverage, allowed enums, proxy behavior, and user-facing safety guidance before implementation.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow Google-only contract
recommendation.body: Add validated Google Generative AI safety settings with explicit request-level values taking precedence, plus focused docs and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior issue review explicitly routed the unresolved product and implementation decision for this exact provider/configuration surface.
